title: Deferred: ExclusionCircuit.verify_embedding compile residual (~1.7× / ~23ms)
body:
## Deferred — do not merge

Independent skeptical review deferred this after publication: equivalence and pin hygiene hold, but the win is a **noisy post-#2001 micro-opt** (~56→33 ms, title 1.71×; independent rebenches ~1.5× with rounds as low as ~1.12×), not a #756-class tooling gain. Absolute wall save is ~20–30 ms on a residual path after merged #2001 already took embedding 323→59 ms.

Keep the packaged evidence on `VictorLiwentao:cursor/exclusion-embedding-compile-60b9` (`research/exclusion-embedding-compile/`). Reopen only if a hotter bottleneck or clearer absolute-time story appears.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Identity claim stands; significance does not meet the upstream bar.

Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance.
